notes:
Sony Mini Recorder over USB is easier, and a damaged card can use its twin.

- Two USB volumes from one handheld: Choose volumes, pick the dates on each, then start
- If a card looks damaged, you can check or try the matching second SD
- Pulling an SD that was never backed up is a small corner notice, not a full-screen takeover
- Pulling a card mid-backup is still the big warning
- How footage is copied and verified is unchanged
